acceptance_scope: Offline applicability of the deliberate dormant-nonrecipient configured-binding guard correction only. Not packet rebinding, current full compatibility acceptance, historical-cause confirmation or operational permission.

prior_accepted_bindings.meaning: Prior accepted source/test hashes are historical scope boundaries, not current wrapper or policy applicability.

deliberate_acceptance_difference.before: Every blank NetworkID on a reviewed network was refused when the inventory name was not a selected application, even for an unrelated dormant nonrecipient.
deliberate_acceptance_difference.after: A previously refused unselected row may pass that eligibility guard only if created, never started, exact-int zero restarts, restart policy no and no existing reserved recipient alias on the reviewed network. It must still pass existing network.project and the full-inventory recipient/ownership checks; this is eligibility relaxation, not unconditional success.
deliberate_acceptance_difference.selected_application_behavior: Unchanged: same never-started/created/exact-int-zero/no-restart restriction for blank IDs and the same subsequent projection and alias checks.
deliberate_acceptance_difference.selected_storage_behavior: Unchanged: selected storage names are in TARGETS but not APP_MODULES, so blank IDs still refuse.
preserved_guards: Network identity validation and the existing single network-inspect command sequence.
Existing network.project rejects wrong/missing/non-string reported IDs, unknown reviewed-network names and contradictory nonempty endpoint/address evidence. The new guard does not bypass projection.
Existing reserved canonical recipient aliases, full metadata traversal and alias-owner conflict detection remain. No unrelated row is discarded or operationally changed.
Running/started, nonzero or boolean restart counts, enabled restart policy, wrong reported network IDs and reserved alias claims still refuse for the newly eligible unselected class.
Raw _bindings, selected application pin/identity/configuration checks and post-start recipient_checks remain unchanged. Projected configuration is not attachment.
Prior fixed-label diagnostic sanitization, installer receipt boundary, legacy envelope handling and fail-before-start/query behavior are unchanged.

change_scope_proof.method: Compared complete in-session accepted source/test snapshots by hash; reversing only the one guard/comment reproduces prior adapter bytes. No git diff against the older dirty baseline was attributed to this change.

observation_review.classification: SHOWN as saved parent observation/replay evidence, not independent native verification
observation_review.interpretation: The supplied accepted-diagnostic replay shows a current eligibility refusal on an unselected row. Old source logic deterministically refuses this class even with the saved dormant/no-reserved-alias witnesses. It does not identify the lost activated-v6c predicate or establish that all later checks pass.
observation_review.limits: Only selected IDs and value-free comparison witnesses are saved, not complete raw inventory/network rows. Numeric restart types, all endpoint/address fields and all projection inputs cannot independently be replayed from this JSON. No corrected 23-container gate pass, full compatibility, healthy service, endpoint/cited query or historical cause is claimed.

remaining_limits: The narrow acceptance-set change is intentional. Other source policies and unchanged guards are not a claim that every possible runtime condition is safe or that the configured gate currently passes.

A separately scoped read-only snapshot replay may show whether the present refusal is cleared; this reviewer performed no fresh capture or host replay and grants no additional observation authority. Any existing parent authorization remains separate.
Changed adapter/test hashes invalidate old exact-current-consumer bindings. No packet, scope, installed-policy record, execution wrapper or old attempt is rebound by this review.

Final alias/attachment, SDK/import/startup, original/replacement endpoint health, clock/pidfd/worker ownership, acknowledgement/recovery, cited retrieval, volume integrity and economics remain outside this offline proof.
Consumed v6c must not retry/reset; removed replacement IDs remain historical. No unrelated-container lifecycle action is permitted or needed by this change.
